Overseas Investment Compliance Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides stepwise compliance diagnosis and planning for outbound and inbound investments, covering central/SOE, private, and personal scenarios.
- Automatically determines asset flow direction before selecting policies and generating compliance frameworks.
- Outputs clear compliance ratings (🟢🟡🔴), approval process charts, risk tags, compliance recommendations, required documents, timeframes, and cost estimates.
- Supports scenarios like ODI filings, foreign investment in China, offshore listings, asset transfer, and policy queries.
- Includes practical case studies, compliance check matrices, and industry/subject mapping for real-world guidance.
